question: Banu Mushtaq scripted history, winning Booker Prize for her short stories collection. What is the name of book?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Heart Lamp**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Banu Mushtaq scripted history, winning Booker Prize for her short stories collection.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Banu Mushtaq** won the **International Booker Prize** in London.

 
 
• 
 
She is the **first Indian author writing in Kannada** to win this prize.

 
 
• 
 
Her award-winning work is **‘Heart Lamp’**, a collection of **twelve short stories**.

 
 
• 
 
The stories are **translated into English** by **Deepa Bhasthi**.

 
 
• 
 
The original Kannada title is **‘Hridaya Deepa’**.

 
 
• 
 
The book covers Mushtaq’s literary work from **1990 to 2023**.

 
 
• 
 
Recognized for vivid portrayals of **familial and societal conflict in Karnataka**.
